headline: Suspended SI Akbar sentenced to death for Rayhan murder in Sylhet
summary: A Sylhet court has sentenced a suspended police officer to death for the 2020 custodial death of Rayhan Ahmad, though five convicts are currently absconding.
details: A Sylhet Metropolitan Sessions Judge Court has sentenced suspended police sub-inspector (SI) Akbar Hossain Bhuiyan to death for the murder of 34-year-old Rayhan Ahmad.
caption:
A suspended police officer has been sentenced to death for the torture and death of a man in police custody in 2020.

A Sylhet Metropolitan Sessions Judge Court has sentenced suspended police sub-inspector (SI) Akbar Hossain Bhuiyan to death for the murder of 34-year-old Rayhan Ahmad.

Source: The Daily Star
